# Levels and the Exp. Share

This game changes no levels. Wild Pokémon and trainers have the levels they have in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, whether or not you take the Exp. Share. The [Exp. Share option](options.md) only decides when you get the item.

With the Exp. Share on, every Pokémon in your party that didn't battle gets half of the battle's base Exp. Points, with the usual bonuses; those that fought get their normal share. You can switch it off and on in the Bag.

A few places are new to this game and so have levels of their own:

- [The Hideaways](underground.md), by your badges.
- [Pal Park's rooms](ramanas-park-pearl.md): level 70, level 100 for the Distortion Room.
- Hidden Grottos: level 25-29.
- The Battle Tower: every Pokémon battles at level 50. See the post-game page.
